summary_1line: After bidding farewell to allies, Rama is offered the celestial Pushpaka chariot by Kubera, but the episode centers on its respectful return to his service.

image_candidates.scene_text: Sugriva and Vibhishana weep while embracing Rama as monkeys, bears, and titans depart with tearful eyes.
The golden Pushpaka chariot appears in the sky at noon, speaking to Rama from above his palace.
Rama stands below, looking up calmly at the radiant celestial chariot floating in the bright sky.
